comment: Deform-bone mapping for the DOAXVV 'Secret Report' Honoka TMC (XNALara-ish MOT* skeleton) -> PD2 LAS player skeleton (names as embedded in the 2B reference model, las_target_skeleton.json). Status: authored 2026-11-15, applied by tools/pd2-las/build_honoko2_dae.py (the TMC-only build that first used it was deleted on 2026-11-15, D40); not the Source-ValveBiped map (that is skeleton_map.json). The TMC stores bone indices in vertex buffers as SLOTS into per-mesh palettes inline in the mesh-bearing WGT_* NodeLay records; load_meshes() attaches the remapped palettes. Anatomy notes: (1) the source has no Spine/Spine1 split - MOT16_Waist is mapped to Spine1 and MOT02_Chest to Spine2, leaving Spine unreferenced by any weight (the LAS bind chain still animates it); (2) the breast physics helpers (OPT_Breast_*) have no LAS counterpart and are unmapped, so their weights merge into Spine2 via the ancestor walk; (3) the 75 skirt physics helpers (OPT_acs_skirtN) are unmapped and merge into Hips via WGT_acs_skirt -> MOT00_Hips, i.e. a RIGID skirt attached to the hips at runtime (LAS has no skirt deform bones); (4) helper/twist bones (OPT_AS_*) are unmapped and merge into their parents (Arm/ForeArm/UpLeg/Leg/Hips); (5) OPT_Hand_{L,R}_{Root,Metacarpal04} are unmapped and merge into LeftHand/RightHand; (6) WGT_* mesh/attachment nodes are unmapped (never skinned after palette remapping is followed by the ancestor walk for helper parents). MOT18/MOT20 (Left/Right toe) map to LeftToeBase/RightToeBase. The wrist-cut for the LAS body is a mesh post-process, not a bone mapping.

target_only.comment: LAS helper/attachment objects the model must define even though the TMC has no equivalent; the 2B template provides them.

drop.comment: Unmapped helper chains, merged into the nearest mapped ancestor by the ancestor walk (see tmc_skeleton_map.json header). Authored for readability; the build's _map_source_bone walk applies to ANY unmapped node.
